encounters.cc: Increasing fatigue, headaches, and uncomfortable itching sensation after showers over the past 6 months

lines: Increasing fatigue, headaches, and uncomfortable itching sensation after showers over the past 6 months
6-month history of increasing fatigue, headaches, and an uncomfortable itching sensation after showers.
He also reports experiencing two episodes of transient visual disturbances in the past month.
- Warfarin 5 mg daily, titrated to INR goal 2.0-3.0
On physical examination, the patient appears plethoric with a ruddy complexion.
His spleen is palpable 3 cm below the left costal margin.

encounters.cc: Rapidly expanding, painful mass in the right groin area 6 hours after elective hernia repair

lines: Rapidly expanding, painful mass in the right groin area 6 hours after elective hernia repair
This patient with polycythemia vera presents.
He underwent an elective right inguinal hernia repair 6 hours ago.
His past medical history is significant for hypertension, which is well-controlled with lisinopril.
- Warfarin 5 mg daily, titrated to INR goal 2.0-3.0
He denies any personal or family history of easy bleeding or bruising.
On examination, his blood pressure is 135/85 mmHg, heart rate is 88 beats per minute, and temperature is 37.2°C (99.0°F).
The right groin is swollen, tense, and tender to palpation.
There is no overlying skin erythema or warmth.
His complete blood count, coagulation profile, and renal function tests are within normal limits.

encounters.cc: Severe, localized thoracic back pain and progressive weakness in both legs for 6 hours

lines: Severe, localized thoracic back pain and progressive weakness in both legs for 6 hours
The 70-year-old male on warfarin with polycythemia vera returns one year after hemorrhage with 6-hour history of severe, localized thoracic back pain and progressive weakness in both legs.
He reports no recent trauma but had an epidural steroid injection for chronic back pain 2 days ago.
- Postoperative hemorrhage following inguinal hernia repair (diagnosed 2021-07-15)
He has been on warfarin therapy.
Decreased sensation to pinprick below the level of the umbilicus and 3/5 strength in the bilateral lower extremities.
Urgent MRI of the thoracic spine is obtained and shows an epidural mass compressing the spinal cord

encounters.cc: Sudden onset of left-sided weakness and slurred speech that began two hours ago

lines: Sudden onset of left-sided weakness and slurred speech that began two hours ago
- Postoperative hemorrhage following inguinal hernia repair (diagnosed 2021-07-15)
He has been noncompliant with his medications, which include metoprolol and warfarin.
On examination, his blood pressure is 160/90 mmHg, heart rate is irregularly irregular at 110 bpm,
He has a left facial droop with left upper and lower extremity weakness.
His laboratory values are as follows:
A non-contrast head CT scan shows no hemorrhage or mass effect.

encounters.cc: Palpitations and mild dyspnea that started 2 hours ago

lines: Palpitations and mild dyspnea that started 2 hours ago
This 72-year-old male with chronic atrial fibrillation and prior ischemic stroke returns to the emergency department with complaints of palpitations and mild dyspnea that started 2 hours ago.
He has been on warfarin for stroke prevention but admits to missing doses over the past week.
- Postoperative hemorrhage following inguinal hernia repair (diagnosed 2021-07-15)
He takes warfarin for stroke prevention.
Blood pressure 150/90 mmHg, heart rate 130 bpm, respiratory rate 18 breaths/min, and oxygen saturation 97% on room air
Irregularly irregular pulse and no signs of heart failure
His current INR is 1.5, below his therapeutic range of 2-3
An electrocardiogram confirms atrial fibrillation with a rapid ventricular response
The decision is made to start intravenous heparin to achieve rapid anticoagulation

encounters.cc: Acute vision loss in right eye described as a 'shade being pulled down' that began one hour ago

lines: Acute vision loss in right eye described as a 'shade being pulled down' that began one hour ago
This 73-year-old male has a history of polycythemia vera, chronic atrial fibrillation, and ischemic stroke.
He presents to the emergency department with acute vision loss in his right eye that began one hour ago.
He describes it as a "shade being pulled down" over his visual field, with no associated pain, floaters, or photophobia.
He denies any history of similar episodes.
- Postoperative hemorrhage following inguinal hernia repair (diagnosed 2021-07-15)
- Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response (diagnosed 2024-07-15)
His past medical history includes poorly controlled hypertension and a prior stroke five years ago, for which he was briefly on antiplatelet therapy but stopped taking it.
He also reports intermittent episodes of palpitations but has not sought evaluation.
He has no known history of diabetes.
- Warfarin 5 mg daily, titrated to INR goal 2.0-3.0
He has a 30 pack-year smoking history
Visual acuity in the right eye is reduced to light perception only.
Intraocular pressure is within normal limits.
A dilated fundoscopic examination is performed, and the image below is obtained.

encounters.cc: Involuntary, violent, flinging movements of left arm and leg that started suddenly while watching television

lines: Involuntary, violent, flinging movements of left arm and leg that started suddenly while watching television

This male with chronic atrial fibrillation, polycythemia vera on warfarin, and prior ischemic stroke and central retinal artery occlusion is brought to the emergency department after suddenly developing involuntary, violent, flinging movements of his left arm and leg while watching television at home.
His wife reports that he has no history of head trauma or similar prior episodes.
- Postoperative hemorrhage following inguinal hernia repair (diagnosed 2021-07-15)
- Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response (diagnosed 2024-07-15)
- Warfarin 5 mg daily, titrated to INR goal 2.0-3.0
He denies weakness, numbness, or visual changes.
Neurologic examination shows hyperkinetic, irregular, large-amplitude movements affecting the proximal musculature of the left upper and lower extremities.
There is no sensory deficit, gait abnormality, or tremor.

encounters.cc: Sudden onset of right-sided weakness, difficulty speaking, and collapse while walking

lines: Sudden onset of right-sided weakness, difficulty speaking, and collapse while walking
Patient with polycythemia vera, atrial fibrillation, and prior stroke.
His wife reports that he was in his usual state of health until he collapsed while walking to the bathroom.
- Postoperative hemorrhage following inguinal hernia repair (diagnosed 2021-07-15)
- Atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response (diagnosed 2024-07-15)
- Warfarin 5 mg daily, titrated to INR goal 2.0-3.0
His blood pressure is 220/120 mmHg, heart rate is 88 beats per minute, and respiratory rate is 18 breaths per minute.
On examination, the patient is drowsy but arousable.
Neurological examination reveals right-sided hemiparesis, expressive aphasia, and a leftward gaze preference.
A non-contrast head CT scan shows a 3 cm hyperdense area in the left basal ganglia with surrounding edema but no midline shift.
